THE MOST INTENSE CRUSHER BASS EXPERIENCE YET

Meet the next generation of Crusher. Crusher 720 takes everything you loved about Crusher Evo and turns it up with our most intense Crusher® Bass experience yet. Deeper and smoother than ever, the bass maintains Evo’s signature intensity while delivering more clarity, detail, and musicality. A redesigned Crusher wheel gives you more precise control over the bass, while THX® Spatial Audio creates a wider, more immersive listening experience. Deeper, softer ear cushions and an improved headband deliver a more comfortable fit, making it easier to listen longer. Add smarter controls, new features, and up to 65 hours of battery life for a Crusher experience that hits harder than ever.

BASS LIKE NO OTHER

The patented Crusher bass delivers a multi-sensory hit you won’t find anywhere else. Our most intense bass experience allows you to adjust the intensity, lock in your vibe, and say goodbye to “normal” headphones forever.

THX® SPATIAL AUDIO

Experience expansive, three-dimensional sound that surrounds you with greater depth, dimension, and realism. THX Spatial Audio and Skullcandy Crusher Bass come together to deliver immersive sound you can hear, and bass you can feel.

POWERFUL SOUND WITH COMFORT

Premium materials and balanced weight distribution deliver a comfortable, secure fit for all-day wear. The prominent Crusher wheel puts bass control right at your fingertips, while nested buttons keep everyday controls intuitive and easy to reach. At 23 grams lighter than a leading competitor, Crusher 720 delivers powerful performance without the extra weight.

SOUND YOUR WAY

Dial in your sound your way with THX Spatial Audio, adjustable Crusher Bass, custom EQs, and a Personal Sound profile. Tweak Stay-Aware Mode, sidetone, and smart features like Multipoint, Low Latency Audio and Wear Detect in the Skullcandy App.

FAQs

What Is Crusher Bass?

Crusher Bass is Skullcandy's patented sensory bass technology that lets you feel low frequencies in addition to hearing them. Unlike traditional headphones, Crusher uses dedicated bass drivers to create a physical bass sensation that adds impact and immersion to music, movies, and games. Use the Crusher wheel or Skullcandy App to adjust the intensity from subtle enhancement to mind-bending bass.

What Is THX® Spatial Audio?

The THX® Spatial Audio you get in Crusher 720 headphones makes you feel like you're surrounded by high-end speakers. The result is truly insane immersion that takes games, music, and movies to another level.

What Is Personal Sound?

Personal Sound by Mimi is advanced sound personalization technology built directly into compatible Skullcandy headphones. Mimi is a global leader in sound personalization technology for consumer audio devices. The technology adapts audio to your specific hearing profile, not a generic preset. The result: Clearer detail, restored audio frequencies you may be missing, safer listening over time and a more immersive experience.

How Do I Turn Crusher Bass On/Off for Crusher 720?

You can adjust Crusher Bass using the Crusher wheel located on the earcup or through the Skullcandy App. Turn the wheel or move the Crusher control in the app to increase or decrease the bass intensity. To turn Crusher Bass off completely, set the control to its lowest level.

How Long Does the Battery Last for Crusher 720 Headphones?

When fully charged, the battery in Crusher 720 headphones can last up to 65 hours. That's easily a week without needing to worry about where you put that charger cable.

How Quick Can I Charge Crusher 720 Headphones?

The rapid charge feature on Crusher 720s enables you to get up to 4 hours of battery in just 10 minutes of charging.

Nice quality headphone compared to

"Nice quality headphone compared to older ones but the sound quality honestly is mid. It definitely makes up for it with the crazy bass but the "spatial audio" is basically non existentent. The sound quality is amazing

"The sound quality is amazing the deep and hard hitting base is insane. My 2 biggest gripes about the head set is with the swivel speakers the headset falls off if im laying down and they are uncomfortable to wear the opposite way. The other odd thing is the connection sequence every time I connect to my phone the OS says connected, then disconnected. It never causes an issue but its an odd quirk that is consistent to every time I pair the device. Other than those 2 minor things I love them. Had Hesh 2s for a long time and this upgrade was well worth it."

"Love them! The bass is strong but not too much for sensitive ears. Not the biggest fan of Spatial Audio but overall I’m extremely satisfied with the sound quality & customization options."

Close 2nd. . . PROs: The 720's

"Close 2nd. . . PROs: The 720's are the best built Crusher I've owned since the Snoop Dogg Special Edition. The design is very sleek and minimal which leaves plenty of room for customization. The new button layout took a minute to get used to but afterwards it became second nature. The fit from the headband down to the muffs, is definitely an improvement from my 540's. I'd go as far to say that the muffs fit so good that it muffled most outside noise better than my ANC 2. (pun intended) CONs: Noticeable drop in bass (pun intended. . . again). The THX Spatial feature almost eliminates all thumps, bringing it to a light tickle."

— Javasya J. (4/5)

These headphones are great! Much

"These headphones are great! Much crisper than the older crusher’s while keeping some good haptic bass. It is my opinion if you are choosing one pair of crusher headphones from Skullcandy and want good haptic crusher then these are fabulous! I would get these! Solid haptics and improved clarity. However, I think if you are going to get/own two headphones - personally I wouldn’t get this one. I would get the 1080 and either ANC 2 or Evo. The 720 occupies a small space in between those headphones. The Evo’s and ANC 2’s have okay sound quality but they kick you in the face with sick haptic response! Super fun! The 1080’s have brilliant sound quality with impressive Spatial Audio and the best sounding bass I have ever experienced! However, they have less rattling haptic crusher. The 720’s are right in between these with good sound, good Spatial Audio and good haptic crusher for a good price."

— Caden S. (5/5)
